title: Palindrome Number
statement: Return true when the integer reads the same forwards and backwards. Negative numbers are never palindromes because of the minus sign. Try it without converting to a string.
hints: Negatives are false immediately, as is any positive multiple of 10 other than 0.
Repeatedly peel the last digit with % 10 and / 10 to build a reversed number.
To dodge overflow entirely, only reverse HALF the digits and stop when the reversed half reaches or passes the remaining half.
complexity: O(number of digits) time, O(1) space
